sections.title: We Are OLSC Lebanon
sections.subtitle: The official home of Liverpool FC supporters in Lebanon — where the Kop spirit lives, from Beirut to every corner of the country.

content.body:
OLSC Lebanon was built for one reason: to bring Liverpool supporters across Lebanon together under one official banner.

We are not just fans who watch a game on a screen. We are a community that shows up — for every kick-off, every last-minute winner, every European night, and every moment that makes this club the greatest in the world.

Whether you joined years ago with an official membership card in your wallet, or you are discovering the Kop for the first time, you belong here. Our committee organizes watch parties, community events, and member experiences that carry the same energy you would feel walking up Anfield Road.

RedLeb Hub is our digital home — Match Hub predictions, your official membership card, community feed, and the leaderboard built on prediction points each season.

This is Liverpool FC in Lebanon. This is us. This is OLSC Lebanon.
content.storyHeading: More than a club. A family in Lebanon.

content.quote: When you walk through a storm, hold your head up high…
content.quoteBody: You'll Never Walk Alone echoes in every OLSC Lebanon watch party — a promise we keep to each other, season after season.

items.title: Official & proud
items.description: OLSC Lebanon is the official Liverpool Supporters Club branch in Lebanon — representing the Reds with passion, respect, and the highest LFC / OLSC standards.

items.title: One family, YNWA
items.description: From Beirut to Tripoli, from watch parties to community events — we stand together through every high and every heartbreak. You’ll Never Walk Alone is not a slogan here. It’s who we are.

items.title: Matchday is sacred
items.description: Every Liverpool match is a shared experience. Predictions, live goal alerts, leaderboard battles, and the roar of the Kop — even thousands of miles from Anfield.

items.title: Lebanon in our DNA
items.description: We are Lebanese. We are Liverpool. Two identities, one spirit — building a supporters community that is proud of where we come from and who we support.

content.body: Official members get access to Match Hub predictions, digital membership cards, community events, and the season leaderboard — the full supporters club experience, built for OLSC Lebanon.

sections.title: Membership
sections.subtitle: Official OLSC Lebanon membership — with a digital card for active members and upload support for existing physical cards.

content.body:
Official membership remains managed by the OLSC Lebanon committee. The Kop Platform provides digital tools for members who already hold official membership.

If you received a physical card in previous seasons, log in and upload a clear photo from the Digital Membership Card page. The committee can use it for faster verification at events alongside your QR code.

content.intro: Whether you are joining for the first time or you already have a printed OLSC card, RedLeb Hub supports both journeys.

content.existingBody: Many members already received a physical OLSC card. Log in and upload a photo — we link it to your digital profile.
